title: Copilot Provider Bridge - Provider Catalog
description: User-editable provider catalog for Copilot Provider Bridge. While this file exists it overrides the bundled defaults; each present section fully replaces the defaults for that section.

providers.description: AI provider groups (endpoint + models). Present sections fully replace the bundled defaults; delete the key to fall back.

visionBackends.description: Multimodal backends used by the built-in Vision Agent tool to analyze images on behalf of text-only models. providerId must match a provider in the effective providers section.

mcpPresets.description: Companion MCP server presets offered by 'Configure MCP Tools'. providerId must match a provider in the effective providers section.

id.description: Stable identity; becomes part of the secret input name (copilot-provider-bridge.<id>.apiKey). Keep built-in ids (zai, deepseek, minimax, kimi, qwen, openrouter, nvidia) unchanged to retain usage/quota tracking.

name.description: Display name shown in QuickPicks and written as the group name in chatLanguageModels.json.

description.description: Short description shown in QuickPick detail rows.

endpointUrl.description: Base endpoint URL for this provider (Anthropic Messages or OpenAI Chat Completions).

secretInput.description: Optional ${input:...} secret name. Defaults to copilot-provider-bridge.<id>.apiKey.

requestHeaders.description: Auth headers sent with chat requests. Defaults to { "Authorization": "Bearer ${apiKey}" }. The literal ${apiKey} is replaced with the entered key.

id.description: Wire-format model id sent to the upstream API.

name.description: Display name in the VS Code model picker.

maxOutputTokens.description: Max generation tokens. Must be smaller than contextWindow.

maxInputTokens.description: Derived as contextWindow - maxOutputTokens when omitted. If provided explicitly it must equal that difference.

thinking.description: Whether the model supports thinking / reasoning.

supportsReasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort levels surfaced in the VS Code model picker.

url.description: Model-level endpoint override (e.g. multimodal variant on a different endpoint).

providerId.description: Provider whose API key is used for this backend.

model.description: Wire-format model id sent to endpointUrl.

name.description: Display name in the Configure MCP Tools QuickPick.

providerId.description: Provider group this preset belongs to in the wizard.

serverKey.description: Key under 'mcp.servers' in mcp.json. Must be unique across presets; Reset uses these keys to identify servers it manages.

inputs.description: Secret inputs resolved by VS Code when starting the server. May be empty for tools that need no key prompt.
